title: Making History (TV series)
production_companies: Julius Sharpe International Petroleum & WritingLord Miller Productions20th Century Fox Television
premise_summary: Making History is an American sitcom created by Julius Sharpe for the Fox Broadcasting Company. Executive-produced by Phil Lord and Christopher Miller and created and written by Sharpe, the show stars Adam Pally, Leighton Meester, and Yassir Lester.
